name: Unplayed History
notes: Brand (owner decision, 2026-11-25). Logo, colors and tagline are pending from the owner; while a value is null the pipeline keeps its current defaults. 'logo' is a path relative to the repo (e.g. assets/brand/logo.png, transparent PNG). Colors are hex strings like "#FF2E88". Changing these restyles only locally drawn cards, thumbnails and text; generated illustrations are never regenerated for branding.
